Frontend: /secret-mod unauthenticated shows ONLY the login gate (mod-login), full panel (secret-mod-panel) absent until correct admin login; wrong password keeps the login gate; correct login (cristimf2007@gmail.com / mfcristi2007!) renders 7 overview cards with real numbers (Fani 2 / Abonați 4 / Online 0 / Logări azi 10 / Mesaje 2 / Piese 6 / Clipuri 12 / Contact 0), UTILIZATORI/ACTIVITATE/LOGURI tabs switch, test fan row shows mute button, clicking it adds 'MUTAT' badge and shows success toast 'Utilizator mutat: TestModerare', activity log renders 22 entries including 'Autentificare admin', 'Cont nou de fan', 'Autentificare cu email'. PlayerBar HIDDEN on /secret-mod (0 instances) ✔. Home page: /logo.png and /artist.jpg both load (no broken images). /muzica track deck: 6 numbered deck rows (01..05+) rendered with .deck-num class. /live desktop 1366px: site header=0, site footer=0, player-bar=0 (all correctly hidden), title 'BIOXIC FEAT. EVEREST MANELE - HAI TE ROG EU, SUNA-MA' renders with proper word spacing (room-track-title uses flex gap-x-[0.3em]), vinyl viewport + transport controls + chat column all visible. /live mobile 390px: viewport fits (scrollH=clientH=844), vinyl not cropped, no overlapping elements per screenshot. Radio audio element present with data-testid='radio-audio', paused by default in headless (autoplay policy). WS /api/ws/chat reconnects visible in console (expected during navigation). The 401 console errors are from /api/auth/me without a cookie — expected unauth check, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed_admin() correctly demotes any role=='admin' user whose email != ADMIN_EMAIL at startup — verified behaviorally (old admin@bioxic.ro no longer admin).
panel_moderate accepts action in {kick, ban, unban, mute, unmute}; input validated via Pydantic ModerateInput. Bad action returns 400. ban upserts by user_id OR email; unban deletes by both. Clean.
is_banned_user matches both user_id and email (lowercased) — covers Google-login users without local password too.
activity_log insert is wrapped in try/except pass — correct: logging never blocks main flow.

SecretMod.jsx cleanly separates login-gate (mod-login) from panel (secret-mod-panel) and gates all data fetches behind the admin cookie/bearer. 401 responses on initial unauth load do not leak any protected data to the DOM.
LiveRoom.jsx room-track-title renders words as separate flex spans with gap-x-[0.3em] — eliminates the 'NICOLAEGUTA' concatenation bug mentioned in the request.
App shell correctly hides header/footer and PlayerBar on /live, /secret-mod, /admin, /clipuri — verified via DOM counts (all 0 on /secret-mod and /live).
No full-screen pointer canvases observed on /clipuri grid (VideoDust removed as expected).
